baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural al-abrar is paired through emphatic in-containment with na'im.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth that makes word and deed hold, together with expansive obedience, defines a durable human integrity; na'im supplies a bestowed condition of pleasant well-being that can contain that integrity.

activation_trace.role: Truth that makes speech or action hold supplies the abrar's durable integrity rather than a bare group label.
Expansive goodness and obedience broadens that integrity into a practiced mode of life.
Pleasant well-being and bestowed favor supplies the encompassing condition in which that integrity is placed.

changed_reading.before: Good people will enjoy a generic bliss.
changed_reading.after: People whose word, deed, and obedience hold together are already described as enclosed in a bestowed condition of well-being.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots permit al-abrar to be heard relationally and na'im as a condition or place that agrees with its occupant.
baseline_models.mechanism: Maintaining kinship and kindness against estrangement meets favor that reaches another and a place congenial to the one who settles there. The verse can therefore stage reciprocity as hospitality rather than depict bliss as an inventory of pleasures.

activation_trace.role: Dutiful connection and kindness against estrangement gives the abrar a specifically relational coherence.
Benefaction reaching another lets na'im function as received hospitality, not self-produced possession.
A place that suits a person turns the preposition fi into an image of fitting habitation.

changed_reading.before: Bliss is a reward possessed by morally approved individuals.
changed_reading.after: Those who preserve relation are received into a congenial hospitality, so na'im is as much right placement as pleasurable content.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus roots join truth that holds with praise and affirmative yes.
baseline_models.mechanism: Al-abrar names lives whose claims survive enactment; the praise and affirmation branches of na'im make their encompassing state resemble a ratifying 'yes.' This is form-distant from the noun's ordinary well-being branch but remains rooted in both focus words.

activation_trace.role: Truth made effective in word or deed supplies what can be tested and ratified.
Praise of something as excellent supplies an evaluative declaration around the abrar.
Affirmative yes supplies the compact image of reality confirming a truth-bearing life.

changed_reading.after: Na'im also carries an exploratory resonance of affirmative recognition: the truth-bearing are situated inside a ratifying yes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence repeatedly opens, scatters, bursts, and overturns large containers. Against that material unbinding, the focus construction places truth-holding persons inside a congenial condition. Na'im becomes a counter-architecture of habitable coherence, not merely a pleasure postponed until after catastrophe.

activation_trace.role: Truth that makes deed hold supplies the inner coherence that the surrounding unbinding tests.
A place agreeing with its occupant supplies a stable, habitable inside.
Opening and splitting begins the loss of enclosing boundaries against which na'im reads as sheltering coherence.
Casting things apart supplies the dispersive force that integrity must outlast.
Wide rupture and outflow turns containment itself unstable.
Overturning earth and exposing what was buried completes the sequence of interiors becoming exteriors.

structural_cues: 82:1-4 repeat an idha frame with passive transformations of enclosing cosmic and earthly domains.
82:13 replaces transformation verbs with an emphatic nominal placement using fi.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four kinds of material unbinding and a focus phrase of in-containment; I infer an inverse relation in which na'im is coherence that remains inhabitable through exposure. A live alternative is that the opening sequence only dates a later reward and does not characterize its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The abrar receive comfort after the world is destroyed.
changed_reading.after: Their na'im is the positive inverse of cosmic disassembly: an inhabitable coherence that holds when every other enclosure opens.

context_deltas.mechanism: A self comes to know both what it advanced and what it deferred. This stretches the truth-bearing force of barr across the whole temporal ledger: the abrar are not a curated moral snapshot but selves whose earlier and later effects can be disclosed without their integrity dissolving.

activation_trace.role: Truth that makes action hold becomes integrity across a fully exposed history.
Well-being supplies the condition that remains after rather than before complete self-knowledge.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the moment when the self's entire pattern becomes visible.
The thing's own self or identity makes the knower and the disclosed moral subject coincide.
Movement ahead supplies deeds and consequences sent forward in time.
Deferral to a later time prevents the reading from excluding delayed acts or effects.

structural_cues: 82:5 assigns one self knowledge of a paired totality: what it advanced and what it deferred.
The focus plural can therefore be read as a class formed from individually disclosed selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-disclosure spanning advance and delay; I infer that barr's truth must survive that complete timeline and that na'im names the resulting unfractured condition. Alternatively, verse 5 may establish only accountability, with no claim that disclosure is internal to na'im.

changed_reading.before: Al-abrar is a fixed honorific for generally good people.
changed_reading.after: Al-abrar are selves whose whole temporal record, including delayed effects, can become known without falsifying their claimed integrity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generosity can become the glitter by which a person mistakes favor for exemption. The context couples that danger with nurture toward completion and then with denial of reckoning. Focus na'im is consequently sharpened as durable benefaction whose truth is borne out in action, not comfortable evidence that consequences have vanished.

activation_trace.role: Truth that holds in action distinguishes genuine response to favor from a flattering self-story.
Bestowed favor remains real but is recoded as benefaction rather than permission to deny consequence.
Deception by what shines but does not hold supplies the false version of pleasantness.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supplies the durable direction of the Lord's generosity.
Honored generosity supplies the real gift that deception misreads.
Contradiction of truth names the endpoint of treating generosity as immunity from account.

structural_cues: 82:6 places deception beside the generous Lord, while 82:9 corrects the addressee's denial of din.
82:13 follows the recording of deeds, so its favor cannot safely be detached from truth-bearing action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive glitter, generosity, completion, and denial; I infer that the same semantic field of favor in na'im is being distinguished from indulgent impunity. A live alternative is that na'im is solely later compensation and does not reinterpret present generosity.

changed_reading.before: Na'im is uncomplicated comfort granted to a favored class.
changed_reading.after: Na'im is favor that proves durable because it is received truthfully; comfort used to deny consequence is its deceptive counterfeit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measurement, straight completion, balance, form, and composition present the human as deliberately fitted. The focus branch in which a place agrees with a person then changes na'im from surplus luxury into congruence: a formed self inhabits a condition suited to truthful and expansive action.

activation_trace.role: Expansive obedience supplies the practiced alignment of the fitted person.
A place agreeing with its occupant makes na'im the experiential fit between person and condition.
Measuring and proportioning supplies deliberate calibration rather than accidental existence.
Straightness and completion within the thing supplies internal wholeness.
Setting a thing upright supplies functional balance.
Given form supplies the concrete configuration in which fit is realized.
Composing one thing into another supplies the assembly of capacities into a person.

structural_cues: 82:7-8 accumulates a five-stage making sequence directed repeatedly at the second-person object.
The focus's fi construction can spatialize the relation between that made person and a fitting condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated making and a focus branch of congenial settlement; I infer that right action and na'im are modes of fit with that making. The live alternative is a simple creator-beneficiary sequence in which bodily formation does not specify the character of later bliss.

changed_reading.before: Na'im is extra pleasure added after moral performance.
changed_reading.after: Na'im can be the felt congruence of a deliberately composed self inhabiting the condition for which truthful, expansive action fits it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guarding, honorable agency, binding inscription, knowledge, and enacted work form an evidentiary chain immediately before the focus. That chain activates the praise and affirmative branches of na'im: the abrar's state can be heard as a verdict borne out by preserved action, while remaining coexistent with experiential well-being.

activation_trace.role: Truth that makes action hold supplies the claim tested by the record.
Affirmative yes supplies the record's positive ratification of the truth-bearing life.
Guarding and close care supplies preservation against evidentiary loss.
Honorable nobility qualifies the recording agency rather than the subjects being recorded.
An inscription that fixes judgment or determination turns observed action into binding evidence.
Disclosure to the knower removes the possibility that the writing is merely mechanical.
Actually bringing about a deed supplies the observable material that can confirm barr's truth.

structural_cues: 82:10-12 forms a compact progression from watchers to honored writers to knowledge of deeds.
82:13 follows that progression without introducing a new narrative scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a preserved evidentiary chain and the focus supplies an affirmative branch; I infer that adjacency lets na'im resonate as positive ratification. A live alternative is that the record only explains eligibility while na'im itself remains wholly non-evaluative well-being.

changed_reading.before: The record determines who later receives bliss.
changed_reading.after: The record also changes the texture of na'im: it is a lived positive verdict in which truth-bearing action is confirmed rather than merely rewarded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact syntactic mirror of verses 13 and 14 aligns two kinds of person with two encompassing media. Barr contributes truth and expansive good while na'im contributes softness and ease; fujur contributes breached restraint and jahim raging heat. Moral patterns thus thicken into environments whose material behavior matches their occupants.

activation_trace.role: Truth that holds supplies the coherent moral material on the positive side of the mirror.
Softness and easeful living gives that coherent material its inhabitable texture.
Deviation from truth and tearing a covering supplies the breached moral material of the opposing class.
Raging fire and intense heat supplies the environment matching that breach.

structural_cues: 82:13 and 82:14 repeat inna plus a plural class, emphatic la-fi, and an indefinite state noun.
The class and environment change together while the containing syntax remains fixed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a perfect grammatical mirror and materially opposed branch images; I infer that each conduct-pattern generates or fits its medium. A live alternative is simple destination contrast with no causal or material correspondence between person and place.

changed_reading.before: Two moral groups are assigned opposite destinations.
changed_reading.after: Integrity and breach become opposite inhabitable materials: truth rests in softness, while torn restraint inhabits intensifying heat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus asserts placement with no future verb before the later sequence repeatedly names the day of account and presses the limits of knowing it. This opens a coexisting temporal reading: the abrar's na'im is a presently valid or timelessly fixed alignment that the bounded event of judgment manifests rather than first creates.

activation_trace.role: Truth that already holds in word and deed supplies a status available before its public disclosure.
A condition of well-being can describe an extant relation as well as a later locale.
A bounded duration supplies the later temporal horizon against which the focus's unmarked assertion stands.
Accounting and recompense specifies what the repeatedly named day publicly settles.
Knowing supplies the repeated epistemic pressure that separates an already declared status from human grasp of its event.

structural_cues: 82:13 is an emphatic verbless assertion rather than an explicit future promise.
The day is named in 82:15 and then repeated in 82:17-19 after the focus assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unmarked emphatic state followed by repeated bounded-day language; I infer that judgment manifests a real alignment rather than manufacturing it. A live alternative is the common certainty-use of a nominal clause for an exclusively future outcome.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts a reward that begins only on judgment day.
changed_reading.after: The verse may declare an already real placement whose full visibility and recompensive force arrive on the named day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing denies every self disposal over anything for another and assigns authority wholly to God. Read back through the focus preposition, the abrar do not own na'im as an asset; they are held inside a favor and fitting hospitality whose continuity rests in divine authority rather than personal control.

activation_trace.role: Kindness that preserves relation supplies a receptive rather than possessive posture.
Bestowed favor identifies na'im as something received rather than controlled.
A place congenial to its occupant supplies the image of being hosted within a condition.
Concealment from sight supplies the negated possibility of escaping an encompassing condition.
Ownership and disposal supplies precisely the agency that the closing negates between selves.
Selfhood repeated on both sides of the relation universalizes the collapse of autonomous control.
Any knowable thing makes the denial of inter-self disposal maximally broad.
Authority and governance supplies the exclusive sustaining agency at the close.
The worshipped God identifies the sole holder to whom that authority is assigned.

structural_cues: 82:13 says the abrar are in na'im rather than saying they possess it.
82:19 negates one self's ownership or disposal for another and then assigns the affair to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grammatical contrast between in-habitation and negated possession plus exclusive authority; I infer that even the positive state is sustained hospitality, not autonomous property. A live alternative is that verse 19 only denies intercession or control during judgment and does not characterize how the abrar relate to na'im.

changed_reading.before: The abrar acquire bliss as their final property.
changed_reading.after: They are hosted within favor they do not autonomously own; its security comes from the authority that sustains it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the dry-land noun branch inside a moral plural. It remains anchored because barr directly supplies dry ground, na'im supplies congenial settlement, and the context makes the seas burst; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial undertone to ethical stability, never as a replacement gloss for al-abrar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins the dry-land branch of barr to the congenial-place branch of na'im through a containing fi construction.

activation_trace.role: Dry land opposed to sea supplies an image of ground that can still bear a person.
A place agreeing with its occupant turns that ground into habitat rather than mere escape.
Vast abundant water supplies the opposed domain whose boundary is about to fail.
Wide rupture and outflow activates the need for ethically imaged ground and fit habitation.

changed_reading.before: The verse has no spatial texture beyond being in bliss.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the wording, the abrar resemble dry-grounded people inside a fitting habitat precisely when the sea can no longer keep its bounds.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the scattering sense belongs to ostrich-flight idiom rather than the ordinary noun na'im. It remains worth carrying because that branch is packet-supplied for the focus root and is sharply activated by the stars' dispersal; render it as a paradoxical resonance in which integrity persists through scattering, not as the lexical meaning of na'im.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's na'im root contains an idiom of group scattering while barr supplies truth that holds and fi supplies continued containment.

activation_trace.role: Truth that makes deed hold supplies continuity of integrity inside rather than outside dispersal.
The ostrich-flight idiom for departure and lost cohesion gives na'im an anomalous scattering resonance.
People dispersing beneath every star makes the star field itself a social image of lost cohesion.
Casting things apart supplies the explicit contextual trigger for the distant focus branch.

changed_reading.before: Na'im is static repose after dispersal ends.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the verse can imagine truth-bearing integrity remaining held even through a total scattering of prior cohesion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it links a courtesy formula of the gladdened eye to the human pupil and the fiery or protruding eye of jahim. It remains anchored in a direct na'im branch and two context inventories; downstream prose should qualify it as an ocular contrast of recognition and consuming intensity, not as an etymological definition of bliss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Na'im carries a focus branch in which a person gladdens the eye, allowing the positive state to acquire a mode of being regarded.

activation_trace.role: Relational kindness supplies the interpersonal quality that can make another's gaze glad.
The formula of an eye gladdened or honored by someone supplies a gaze-based texture for na'im.
The human image reflected in the pupil makes personhood and seeing materially intersect.
The blazing or protruding eye supplies the harsh ocular counter-image to a gladdened gaze.

changed_reading.before: Na'im concerns only what the abrar feel or possess.
changed_reading.after: Na'im may also resonate as how they are received in relation: a gaze gladdened by their presence rather than a gaze inflamed into consuming intensity.

strongest_changes: The opening unbinding sequence turns na'im into habitable coherence that persists when every other enclosure opens.
The recording sequence activates na'im as positive ratification of truth-bearing action alongside, not instead of, well-being.
The making sequence recasts ease as fitted congruence between a composed self and its proper condition.
The exact 82:13-14 mirror materializes integrity and breach as opposite environments of softness and raging heat.
The closing denial of ownership recasts na'im as sustained hospitality rather than an autonomously possessed asset.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus predicate remained unusually generative across moral, relational, spatial, evidentiary, embodied, temporal, and proprietary mechanisms. Its strongest surprise was that fi na'im behaved less like a catalogued reward than like an encompassing medium whose coherence, fit, verdict, and giver become visible under contextual pressure.
remaining_uncertainties: The praise and affirmative-yes branches of na'im are morphologically live but form-distant from the focus noun, so the verdict reading should coexist with rather than replace well-being.
The inference from calibrated creation to ethical or environmental fit is directional work supplied by the reader, not an explicit causal statement in the packet.
The emphatic nominal clause may express future certainty rather than an already present state.
The terrain, scattering, and ocular readings are packet-anchored resonances whose lexical distance requires explicit containment.
